description: PA TrendRider XAU v1 demo execution: H1/M15 structure bias, M5 BOS pullback entry, one guarded position with mandatory SL/TP, risk-budgeted lot, daily/drawdown locks and a kill-switch file. Execution enabled by default on demo (ADR 0006); set InpEnableExecution=false for a dry-run comparison. Demo account or Strategy Tester only.

assumptions.account: demo or Strategy Tester only; real/contest accounts are rejected at OnInit
assumptions.symbol: XAUUSDm: point 0.001, 3 digits, tick value 0.1 per lot per tick; measured spread about 260 points
assumptions.position_model: one broker position filtered by symbol and InpMagicNumber; no hedging, grid, DCA or averaging
assumptions.lot_sizing: tick size and tick value with the risk budget; floored to the broker volume step; rejected if the minimum lot exceeds the budget
assumptions.take_profit: mandatory at InpTakeProfitR times the initial risk; SL and TP are re-asserted if the broker drops them
assumptions.commission: budgeted for sizing; the broker charges the real commission
assumptions.slippage: InpMaxSlippagePoints is passed as order deviation; no positive-slippage assumption
assumptions.swap: not modelled by the EA; the broker applies it to the position
assumptions.kill_switch: create InpKillSwitchFile in MQL5/Files to close the position and stop entries until restart
assumptions.state: risk ledger and position context persisted to MQL5/Files; delete or reset the state file before a clean replay
assumptions.results: demo execution is an operational check, not a performance or live-readiness claim
